The *Visākhā Sutta* (Ud 8.8, PTS Ud 91) is the eighth discourse of the eighth chapter of the *Udāna*. In this sutta, the prominent lay disciple Lady Visākhā expresses a wish for many grandchildren.

 The text is also cited in post-canonical Pali exegetical treatises, specifically the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 1) and the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 15).

 Cross-language automated alignments also detect shared passages with a Tibetan canonical text (BO_K01_D0005_H0005) and the Chinese *Ekottarika-āgama* (T 125) [DharmaNexus]. None of the secondary literature passages in the dossier directly discuss Ud 8.8, referring instead to other canonical discourses or commentarial narratives concerning Lady Visākhā or the male disciple Visākha.
